subject: [hw] DONE T02 rev 2: R1 lock-during-sleep note fixed (6166/6166)
body:
Rev 2 only: tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c no longer holds the instance mutex while sleeping. DELAY_US and each POLL retry now unlock, sleep, relock; wait_irq already did. Added test_poll_thread (one thread polls VENC 0x1c, the main thread writes it 20 ms later). No interface or grammar change.

Last lines:
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6166/6166
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22
(ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan for the hw suite; R1 accepted the previous rev, this is the note fix.)

Not-done list unchanged: 40-daemon-encode is a template pending hw-ip/hw-p03 names; run_phone_tests.sh needs $PHONE_EXEC; rwvc_probe iOS link not done; no phone run; fake POLL uses a global timeout because the frozen regs() callback has no poll_timeout field. STATUS in dsh-state/workers/T02 updated. Staying available for hw-r2 and integrators.
